data.title: 鸢一折纸 · 整备台上的检查记录
data.description: 折纸穿闭合的灰色技术夹克，戴工作手套坐在明亮整备台前。她把停机检测仪平放在防滑垫上，一手按住外壳，另一手检查连接线插口；白发、蓝眼和所有工具都处在均匀灯光下，墙面工具架延伸到画幅边缘。
data.action: 按稳检测仪外壳，检查连接线插口。
data.promptProse: In the maintenance room, Origami braces an inactive diagnostic unit flat on a rubber mat with one gloved hand and checks its cable connector with the other. Her closed grey technical jacket and short white hair frame pale-blue eyes fixed on the connection. The vertical medium view extends through bench surfaces, wall panels and tool racks. Broad overhead work lights illuminate her face and casing evenly, with soft shadows under tools.
